Title: Measure simulator speed on this machine
Description: Run kit evaluate.py for 576 steps on one small, one median and one large generated building; read seconds_per_step from summary.json.
Definition of done: Table of seconds per step by building size in docs/SOURCES_AND_FACTS.md; WORKERS and STEPS in run_pipeline.sh chosen from it.

Title: Set up LLM credentials and a spending cap
Description: Install requirements-llm.txt; configure ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or ant auth; decide a budget per run and per generation.
Definition of done: A one-candidate proposer call succeeds; the budget is written in docs/RUNBOOK.md; key not committed.

Title: Review the universal constants once
Description: Check every value in code/discovery/universal_constants.json against the kit code and STATE_SPACE.md; add any missing universal constant the formulas may need (e.g. 10 W/m2 gains, 0.2 standby).
Definition of done: Each constant has a cited source; _reviewed is set to true; the dry-run prompt shows the reviewed table.

Title: Run step 2 of the pipeline: generate buildings, scenarios and runs
Description: ./run_pipeline.sh with FROM=1 TO=2 using the default seeds (train 500-599, val 700-719, test 800-819) and the five shipped policies.
Definition of done: data/plan.json and data/split.json exist; every planned run has summary.json or a recorded failure; kit unchanged.

Title: Handle rejected seeds by oversampling
Description: The kit rejects seeds whose plan has a room under 20 m2. Add an option to generate_data.py to top up each split with extra seeds until a target number of accepted buildings is reached.
Definition of done: --target-buildings N (or equivalent) yields N accepted buildings per split; failures listed in plan.json; split sizes reported.

Title: Decide training episode length
Description: Compare 2,016-step and 8,640-step training runs for discovery quality versus cost (a small subset).
Definition of done: Decision written in docs/RUNBOOK.md with numbers; STEPS default updated if needed.

Title: Add more excitation policies for identification
Description: Shipped policies may not excite slow dynamics. Add kit-compatible policies (random setpoint holds, step tests, night set-backs) run through evaluate.py without modifying the kit (e.g. a policy file in working-code registered at run time).
Definition of done: At least two extra policies produce replayable runs; replay check passes; dataset includes them behind a flag.

Title: Weather hold-out design
Description: Only 48 windows from 6 stations exist. Decide which stations are train / val / test and whether to rotate (cross-validation by station).
Definition of done: Split rule documented; split.json reflects it; at least one station never seen in train.

Title: Generate the 30 shipped scenarios at 8,640 steps
Description: Run evaluate.py on all 30 shipped scenarios for all policies (include_shipped) as a fixed benchmark comparable with baseline_returns.json.
Definition of done: 30 x 5 runs present; scores match baseline_returns.json within rounding.

Title: Audit the raw data (step 3)
Description: Run code/audit_data.py on the generated data; investigate every hard failure.
Definition of done: data/audit/ report has no hard failures, or each one is explained and excluded.

Title: Build the dataset (step 4) and re-audit (step 5)
Description: Run build_dataset.py with all workers; replay every run; reject runs whose replay does not match.
Definition of done: data/dataset/index.json lists all runs with status; replay flow error <= 2% for accepted runs; audit passes.

Title: Dataset summary report
Description: Counts by split, building size, station, season, policy; distributions of rooms, AHUs, materials; total steps.
Definition of done: docs/DATASET_REPORT.md generated by a script and checked in.

Title: Speed up replay for large buildings
Description: Profile starterkit_data.replay and episode_inputs on a 150+ room building; vectorise hot loops.
Definition of done: Replay of a full 8,640-step large-building run is at least 3x faster with identical output (hash-equal arrays).

Title: Per-room constants script from floor_plan and zone_map only
Description: Standalone CLI that takes the two .npy arrays (and AHU assignment) and writes every per-room and per-pair geometry quantity episodes.geometry computes, plus any extra quantities the formulas may need (e.g. corner flag, perimeter by orientation, distance to AHU).
Definition of done: code/geometry_cli.py writes a CSV/JSON per building; values equal episodes.geometry on all shipped buildings; documented in DISCOVERY_WALKTHROUGH.md.

Title: Extend geometry with more candidate quantities
Description: Reference the simulator code to add quantities that could matter: exterior wall cells by orientation, partition length to exterior rooms, room aspect ratio, number of neighbours, slab area.
Definition of done: New fields available in geo; listed in the prompt's data dictionary; unit tests on a toy floor plan.

Title: Boiler water temperature as an explicit input
Description: Expose T_water (already in the replay actions) to candidates, not only through Q_reheat.
Definition of done: inputs['T_water'] present in episodes and in the prompt; existing candidates unaffected.

Title: Occupant split between rooms
Description: Implement and compare options for assigning the building occupant count to rooms: by area, equally, by time-of-day rule.
Definition of done: Option selectable; effect on seed scores reported; decision recorded.

Title: Decide whether to discover the command-to-heat conversion
Description: Today g, T_supply and Q_reheat are computed by hand-written equipment laws. Decide whether the LLM should also propose that part.
Definition of done: Decision recorded with reasoning; if yes, a ticket for the contract change is created.

Title: Review the dry-run prompts end to end
Description: Run --proposer dry on the real dataset; read the system prompt and every operator prompt; fix unclear wording, missing data-dictionary entries, wrong units.
Definition of done: Reviewed prompts committed as examples; a reviewer other than the author signs off.

Title: Decide how much simulator structure goes into the prompt
Description: Open question: graph only, or the full physics chain (informed notes). Run both variants for a few generations.
Definition of done: Comparison of best scores after N generations for both variants; decision recorded.

Title: History summary options in the prompt
Description: Offer the LLM explicit choices: raw lags, differences, window averages, exponential averages, LLM-proposed features; document them in the contract.
Definition of done: Contract text updated; at least one seed uses each pattern; self-test still passes.

Title: Prompt size and cost control
Description: Measure tokens per request; trim parent code and analysis when long; use prompt caching for the system prompt.
Definition of done: Tokens and cost per generation logged in log.md; requests stay under the chosen limit.

Title: Robust parsing of LLM answers
Description: Handle malformed JSON, missing fields, code fences, duplicate names; retry once with an error message.
Definition of done: Unit tests with malformed responses; a failed parse is logged as a rejected candidate with the reason.

Title: Optional second LLM provider via the inbox
Description: Document and test the dir proposer workflow so another LLM or a person can answer requests.
Definition of done: A full generation completed through inbox/ files; steps in RUNBOOK.md.

Title: Choose the MPC horizon used for the score
Description: Open question. Measure how controller quality depends on horizon once a controller exists; until then keep 3 h.
Definition of done: Decision recorded; --main-horizon default updated.

Title: Fast evaluation without Nelder-Mead or backprop
Description: Closed-form candidates need no optimiser. Profile closedform.evaluate on the full validation set; parallelise across episodes; cache prepare().
Definition of done: One candidate evaluates on the full val split within the chosen budget (e.g. < 2 min); time per candidate logged.

Title: Parallel candidate evaluation
Description: Evaluate the candidates of a generation in parallel worker processes with a per-candidate timeout.
Definition of done: --workers N in evolve.py; same results as serial on the self-test; wall time scales with N.

Title: Stronger physics checks
Description: Add checks: symmetry of exchange between two identical rooms, no heat created by neighbours, monotone response to outside temperature, sensitivity to history length.
Definition of done: New checks in closedform.physics_checks with tests; a known-bad candidate fails each.

Title: Score the open-loop (long free run) as a diagnostic
Description: Report 24 h and full-episode free-run error and drift, not only 1/3/6 h.
Definition of done: Extra metrics in database records and REPORT.md.

Title: Calibrate the stage-1 screen
Description: Pick screen_factor from data so good structures are not discarded early.
Definition of done: Histogram of one-step/persistence ratios for seeds and early candidates; chosen value recorded.

Title: Ceiling per building on train and val
Description: Run --ceiling on the full dataset; report per building and per policy.
Definition of done: ceiling.json for the main run; ceiling shown in REPORT.md plots.

Title: First real LLM run (small)
Description: 3 islands, 3 generations, default operators, on a subset of val episodes, to check cost, failure modes and logs.
Definition of done: REPORT.md with real LLM candidates; failure reasons reviewed; cost per generation known.

Title: Full discovery run
Description: Islands, migration and generation count chosen from G1; run until the best score stops improving.
Definition of done: Best candidate beats persistence at 1, 3 and 6 h on val and test; REPORT.md and best.py committed.

Title: Pre-crossover / pre-mutation analysis improvements
Description: Add template-level ablation (zero one template's term and measure the change), per-template attribution, and residual correlation with geometry features.
Definition of done: analysis.md includes the ablation table; tested on the self-test.

Title: Diversity and novelty control
Description: Avoid near-duplicate candidates: AST similarity filter, behavioural diversity (error profile) when choosing parents.
Definition of done: Duplicate rate reported per generation; diversity setting in evolve.py.

Title: Operator statistics and adaptive operator mix
Description: Track success per operator and shift the number of requests toward operators that improve parents.
Definition of done: Adaptive mode behind a flag; operator table in REPORT.md shows the change.

Title: Resume and checkpoint long runs
Description: Make sure interrupted runs resume without duplicate requests; store proposer responses before evaluation.
Definition of done: Kill and resume test on the self-test leaves database consistent.

Title: Mock-proposer regression test in CI
Description: Run --selftest in CI (or a shorter version) so the machinery cannot silently break.
Definition of done: CI job green; fails when the scorer misaligns history and targets.

Title: Report for real runs: plots per building and per climate
Description: Extend REPORT.md with error by building size, station, season and policy.
Definition of done: Tables and plots present for the main run.

Title: Lineage visual that renders on GitHub
Description: Mermaid tree already exists; add a static PNG for viewers without mermaid.
Definition of done: plots/lineage.png generated per run.

Title: Candidate comparison page
Description: Side-by-side diff of a parent and child with both analyses and scores.
Definition of done: report.py writes compare/<child>.md for every mutation and crossover.

Title: Final test-split evaluation of the best model
Description: Score best.py once on the test split (unseen buildings and station).
Definition of done: Test numbers in summary.json and REPORT.md; never used for selection.

Title: Evaluate on the 30 shipped scenarios at 8,640 steps
Description: Comparable benchmark across team members and with the kit's numbers.
Definition of done: Per-scenario forecast errors for best.py, persistence and ceiling.

Title: Early-episode behaviour
Description: Measure error in the first hours while the history buffer fills; confirm it is acceptable.
Definition of done: Plot of error vs hours since episode start; decision recorded.

Title: Robustness to large buildings
Description: Check best.py on the largest generated buildings (150+ rooms) for error and time per step.
Definition of done: Error and ms/step reported; time within budget.

Title: Closed-form model tracker inside the policy
Description: Equivalent of runtime/online_model.py for closed-form candidates: build geometry from metadata, keep the history buffer from observations and own commands, compute inputs, call step() to forecast.
Definition of done: code/runtime/closedform_tracker.py; live forecasts inside run_policy.py equal offline closedform scores on the same episode.

Title: Wire run_pipeline step 8 for closed-form models
Description: run_policy.py accepts a closed-form best.py and reports live forecast error and ms/step.
Definition of done: DEPLOY=closedform runs step 8 end to end.

Title: Handle the one-step observation delay
Description: Observations show the state one step late and the first AHU start is delayed; make the tracker consistent with replay.
Definition of done: Unit test comparing tracker inputs with replayed inputs step by step.

Title: Time budget check
Description: Measure tracker + forecast time per step on the largest building.
Definition of done: Below the controller's share of the ~0.125 s per-step budget.

Title: Safe baseline submission
Description: Package a pid_water-like policy in the Kaggle notebook format and submit it.
Definition of done: Public leaderboard score recorded; notebook in the repo.

Title: Feed-forward controller using the model
Description: Use model forecasts to pre-heat/pre-cool before comfort hours and coast at the end of the day; PID trims.
Definition of done: Beats pid_water on the 30 shipped scenarios at 8,640 steps.

Title: Sampling MPC over a reduced action
Description: CEM/MPPI over per-AHU setpoints and a per-room allocation rule; score candidates with the reward on predicted trajectories.
Definition of done: Beats the feed-forward controller on the shipped set and a generated hold-out within the time budget.

Title: Energy and carbon cost proxy
Description: Implement the control cost: fan power ~ damper x pressure^1.5, cooling and gas from temperatures, reference scaling with number of AHUs.
Definition of done: Proxy vs kit reward_components correlation reported on shipped runs.

Title: Occupancy forecast
Description: Forecast building occupancy from the schedule flags and time of day for the comfort term.
Definition of done: Forecast error reported; used by MPC.

Title: Equipment on/off rules
Description: Decide AHU and boiler on/off by rule from predicted coast time.
Definition of done: Rule documented; ablation against always-on reported.

Title: Kaggle notebook template
Description: Notebook subclassing smart_buildings_inference_server.Policy; reads indices from metadata; loads weights/model files from an attached Kaggle Dataset; no internet.
Definition of done: Notebook runs the public example scenario on Kaggle without errors.

Title: Action safety layer
Description: Clip to bounds, replace NaN/inf, fall back to a safe action on any exception.
Definition of done: Fuzz test with random and NaN model outputs never produces an invalid action.

Title: Package the discovered model as a Kaggle Dataset
Description: Upload best.py, constants and any precomputed data; version it.
Definition of done: Dataset attached to the notebook; notebook loads it in __init__ within 15 min.

Title: Local full rehearsal before each submission
Description: Run the notebook's policy through evaluate.py on the 30 shipped scenarios at 8,640 steps and score with score_leaderboard.py.
Definition of done: Local score and wall time recorded per submission candidate.

Title: Choose the two final submissions
Description: Pick one safe and one ambitious submission before Jan 15, 2027.
Definition of done: Both selected on Kaggle; rationale recorded.

Title: Unit tests for the discovery package
Description: Tests for contract loading, sandbox (numpy internals allowed, os blocked), Prepared/rollout alignment, physics checks, analysis, mock operators.
Definition of done: pytest suite under tests/; passes locally and in CI.

Title: GitHub Actions CI
Description: Run unit tests and a short self-test on every push.
Definition of done: Workflow file committed; badge in README.

Title: Lint and format
Description: Add ruff configuration; fix warnings in code/.
Definition of done: ruff passes in CI.

Title: Keep the deck in sync with results
Description: Regenerate the deck figures from the main run (docs/deck_src); replace self-test examples with real LLM candidates.
Definition of done: Deck shows real discovery results; every figure's source line is correct.

Title: Paper for the final round (Jan 15, 2027)
Description: Write the method, results and ablations in the competition template.
Definition of done: Submitted on OpenReview.

Title: Update STATE_SPACE.md to the closed-form approach
Description: Bring the long design document in line with the no-fitting default and the 30-day results.
Definition of done: No section contradicts DISCOVERY_WALKTHROUGH.md or SOURCES_AND_FACTS.md.

Title: Goal: best Kaggle score or a generic discovered model
Description: Decide what to optimise when they conflict.
Definition of done: Decision recorded in docs; tasks re-prioritised.

Title: Real-building plan
Description: If invited to test on real buildings: first try the same universal constants; add filtering of noisy sensors.
Definition of done: Plan written; filtering method chosen.
